name: Lab Settlement
description: A tiny test settlement exercising every node-surface schema shape. Used by automated tests and manual lab sessions; not part of any campaign.

lab_square.name: Lab Square
lab_square.blurb: The heart of the lab settlement; a notice board stands by the well.
lab_square.description: You stand in a small square ringed by test buildings. A notice board leans beside a well, papered with parchments.

lab_tavern.name: The Testing Tankard
lab_tavern.blurb: A warm tavern for exercising talk, shop, and rest.
lab_tavern.description: Woodsmoke and spilled ale. The taproom is quiet; a fire crackles in the hearth.

lab_gate.name: The Old Gate
lab_gate.blurb: A sealed gate bearing a strange symbol.
lab_gate.description: A rusted gate blocks a stairwell descending into darkness. A symbol is scratched into the lintel.

actions.on_success: The symbol is a ward against the restless dead — someone sealed this gate on purpose.
actions.on_failure: The scratches look old and deliberate, but their meaning escapes you.

transition.on_success: The gate groans open, and stale air rolls up from the dark.
transition.on_failure: You heave at the gate, but it will not budge.
